# structured-gist

> A Claude Code skill that renders explanatory or process-recap output as a nested outline instead of a paragraph, using a fixed four-role marker ladder (concept, attribute, enumerator, explanation). Offered for training/fine-tuning reuse, not only interactive use — see README "Reuse and training".

## Core

- [README](README.md): motivation, method, before/after demonstration, installation, usage.
- [SKILL.md](skills/structured-gist/SKILL.md): the complete specification — activation syntax, marker taxonomy, all 15 linter rules, render-mode detail.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for a coding agent invoking or extending this skill.

## Reference

- [reference/render-modes.md](skills/structured-gist/reference/render-modes.md): block vs. responsive mode, worked examples.
- [reference/composition.md](skills/structured-gist/reference/composition.md): how the skill composes with text-compression layers.
- [reference/self-explain-notes.md](skills/structured-gist/reference/self-explain-notes.md): the skill's own docs rendered in its own format.
- [reference/install.md](skills/structured-gist/reference/install.md): installation detail.
- [reference/kg-mode.md](skills/structured-gist/reference/kg-mode.md): the experimental KG generation path.

## Examples

- [examples/standard.md](skills/structured-gist/examples/standard.md): the standard granularity level, the only shipped level. Archived skim and deep examples: [docs/archive/granularity/](docs/archive/granularity/).
- [examples/attribute.md](skills/structured-gist/examples/attribute.md): the attribute marker in isolation.
- [examples/report.md](skills/structured-gist/examples/report.md): the opt-in report preset, two findings with differing branch sets.
- [examples/caveman-combo.md](skills/structured-gist/examples/caveman-combo.md): structured-gist composed with caveman wording compression.
- [examples/self-explain.md](skills/structured-gist/examples/self-explain.md): the skill's own docs, self-rendered.
- [examples/splice-to-subtree.md](skills/structured-gist/examples/splice-to-subtree.md): before/after worked examples of the R9 delimiter-split rule.
